integrity: The determinant identity, angular equality cases, universal injectivity and unique radial optimum have analytic proofs. A standalone numerical checker provides only finite supplementary diagnostics. Historical priority remains subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to nine coherent intensity lifts on three concentric equilateral orbits and additive constant-variance noise; it neither optimizes arbitrary nine-point designs nor establishes a sharp condition number or Poisson-count optimum. Numerical radii are approximations; an exact unique implicit characterization is proved.
title: Staggered equilateral orbits are uniquely volume-optimal for nine Gaussian coherent measurements
